messages:
maya: quick scrub — cross-team quant deliverables. owners + next milestone? especially quant recs + batching/caching. any regressions we should flag? pinging owners @ben @shreya @daniel
ben: I'm owner for the q-recs doc. plan: recommend q4_m and int8 fallback. landing PR today (DRAFT: https://git.internal/redwood/optkit/PR4123). need perf numbers from eng-runtime for 1k/2k seq.
shreya: running perf runs now, will post numbers by EOD. early: q4_m stable for 512/1024, int8 better latency but slightly fuzzier on rouge. noting eval regressions on summarization set.
daniel: can you drop the eval diffs? if regressions >2% we need canary. also cc @qa-jordan for regression tests.
qa-jordan: I'll run the regression harness when PR is ready. can you add the failing prompts to the failing_prompts/ folder in QA bucket? also please add a small smoke test against sample doc.
ben: ack. adding smoke test and linking to PR. also suggesting batching default: continuous batching with max_batch_tokens=1024, prefer max_latency_ms=50. will include as config snippet:
```
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_latency_ms: 50
  prefix_cache: enabled
```
shreya: on caching — recommend prefix-level cache for repeated system prompts, KV warmup for chat sessions. we'll add heuristics to disable for very short sessions.
leo: infra note — Dedicated pools need to be labeled `opt-kit-canary` for canary traffic. infra-bot will provision after PR merged.
infra-bot: provisioning request received: pool=opt-kit-canary, gpus=4, region=us-west-2. ETA 2h.
ben: blockers: need runtime kernel change for q4_m pad handling — PR #4231 in eng-runtime. tagging @daniel for review.
daniel: reviewing now, hope to merge today if tests pass.
maya: ok plan: ben finish PR + tests, daniel merge runtime PR, infra provision, qa run harness, then canary rollout. flag if any regression >1.5%.
shreya: noted. I'll post numeric results once runs complete.
ben: also calling out a small perf regression on embedding latency with q4_m on long contexts — adding to the delivery spreadsheet.
maya: thanks everyone — short async checkin, I'll update the project board when PRs merged. :thumbsup:
